messages.subject: Project Harbor — CPSE.1 enquiries
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Our CPSE.1 enquiries are attached for the Seller's replies. We'd be grateful for particular attention to: the outstanding Penrose Analytics rent review; the Harbourside Media break in September 2026; the informal parking arrangement with No. 9; and confirmation the Clydesford Bank charge will be discharged on completion.

James
